reason: Research was limited: two searches for the 2026-10-30 oil, energy and Treasury-yield tape returned only undated or April 2026 material, so I could not confirm the late-October moves that a change would depend on. The book is +3.88% with a diversified core of dividend names (JNJ, PG, KO, MCD, ABT, MMM), a 12% XLE overweight that is still up 8.75% on its entry, a TLT short that is flat, and 39.5% cash earning 4% APY, and no leg has breached a stop or needs a take-profit. Replacing the book would cost churn on every leg for a rotation I could not verify, so holding beats trading on this evidence. This decision rests mainly on the packet marks rather than confirmed late-October market data.
